profile.name: WINFRED MUMBUA MUKONZA
profile.headline: Strategic and visionary Program Leader with 18+ years of progressive experience driving large-scale development and humanitarian programs across Kenya.
profile.about:
Strategic and visionary Program Leader with 18+ years of progressive experience driving large-scale development and humanitarian programs across Kenya. Proven expertise in program design and management, child protection, sponsorship operations, gender equality, disability inclusion, community development, WASH, education, resilience, and emergency response.

A seasoned leader in donor engagement, resource mobilization, staff management, safeguarding, budget oversight, partnership coordination, and MEAL, with a strong record of delivering results on time, on budget, and on target. Known for strengthening systems, building high-performing teams, and driving impact at scale in both development and humanitarian contexts.

Successfully led World Vision’s global "Chosen Project" sponsorship model, bringing onboard 50,000+ new sponsors in three years. Skilled at strengthening country-level program quality, ensuring compliance, improving accountability, and maintaining strong relationships with government, civil society, donors, and community stakeholders.

skills: Staff Coaching, Capacity Strengthening & Team Leadership
Multi-sector Program Management: WASH, SRHR, Education, Livelihoods
Program strategy development, influencing and advocacy
Technical skills: Microsoft Office Suite, Digital Collaboration Tools

experience.role: Country Sponsorship Manager / Program Unit Manager
bullets: Key achievements
Revitalized sponsorship engagement, improving donor retention and child-sponsor communication through digital innovation.
Produced high-quality donor reports that met strict compliance standards, leading to continued and increased funding.
Strengthened partnerships with government, CSOs, and community groups, enhancing program reach and impact in Kilifi County.
Achieved consistent timely responses to audit findings, strengthening accountability and compliance.
Strengthened Plan International’s visibility through high-level representation in fundraising and decision-making platforms.
Established regular staff performance review systems, including monthly program meetings to monitor progress, expenditure, and technical support needs.
Experiences:
Provides strategic and technical leadership for Child Sponsorship Program, Community Development, Emergency Response, Child Protection, Gender Equality, Health & Nutrition, Education, and WASH.
Oversees countrywide sponsorship operations, ensuring business rules, compliance standards, and safeguarding requirements are met.
Leads coordination between Country Office, Regional Hub, Global Hub, and National Offices to strengthen sponsorship business processes.
Contributes to Extended Country Leadership Team (ECLT) for program strategy, risk management, resource planning, and performance oversight.
Represents Plan International in national and county-level coordination platforms, including Education, Gender, Disaster Management, Youth, Agriculture, and Water technical working groups.
Strengthens partnerships with government, CSOs, and community structures to support program implementation and resource mobilization.

experience.role: Area Programs Manager – Machakos, Kitui & Kilifi
bullets: Oversaw large-scale development programs and sponsorship operations with an annual budget exceeding USD 2.5M, across multiple counties, delivering integrated interventions in Education, WASH, Nutrition, Maternal & Child Health, Gender & Disability, and Child Protection.
Key achievements:
Recognized nationally for excellence in financial management, timely reporting, and partnership coordination (2017–2019).
Piloted and scaled the World Vision ‘Chosen Project’ in 2019, a new sponsorship model that attracted over 50,000 new sponsors within three years.
Secured significant grant funding through collaborative proposal development and donor engagement.
Achieved over 95% implementation rate of annual plans and budgets, consistently meeting organizational targets.
Recognized as Best Performing Program Manager (National & Regional) in 2017, 2018 & 2019 for excellence in reporting, accountability, and program quality.
Awarded for outstanding performance in coordination, collaboration & capacity building for partnerships.
Experiences:
Led integrated Area Programs addressing child wellbeing, education, WASH, gender, disability inclusion, and health across three counties.
Managed annual sponsorship budget exceeding USD 2.5M and multiple grant-funded projects, ensuring timely implementation, financial accountability, and donor compliance.
Directed community mobilization, stakeholder engagement, and capacity building initiatives to foster local ownership and sustainability.
Led programs that achieved top national ranking in Financial Management in 2018, with exceptional accountability and transparency.
Successfully implemented the new World Vision sponsorship model (Chosen Project), onboarding 50,000+ sponsors globally.
Contributed to development of World Vision Kenya’s 2016–2020 National Strategy through extensive community engagement and evidence generation.
Led successful resource mobilization, including concept development and donor engagement.
Maintained strong audit performance through proactive risk mitigation and implementation of recommendations.
Facilitated major donor engagements and high-level visits for fundraising and impact reporting.
Strengthened partnerships with county governments and CSOs to advance child well-being outcomes.

experience.role: Community Development Motivator / Project Officer, Sponsorship
bullets: Supported implementation of community development and sponsorship programs across Makueni and Mwala. Delivered projects in Child Protection, Disability Inclusion, Community Health, Advocacy, and Education.
Accomplishments:
Successfully implemented Detailed Implementation Plans (DIP) annually, meeting all donor reporting requirements.
Strengthened disability mainstreaming and child protection systems in collaboration with government ministries and stakeholders.
Enhanced community empowerment and local governance structures, improving program sustainability.
Successfully coordinated project activities within annual Detailed Implementation Plans.
Delivered all donor reporting requirements with consistent quality and timeliness.
Coordinated disability programming with government agencies (Health, Children’s Services).
Led capacity building and community empowerment initiatives at international, national & county levels, strengthening World Vision’s reputation as a credible actor in child well-being.
